story.title: AMD acquires Taalas to boost inference performance by etching models in silicon

draft:
AMD's acquisition of Taalas signals a significant shift in AI chip development. 
I'm intrigued by the potential of etching models into silicon to boost inference performance. 
This approach could lead to major efficiency gains and faster processing times. 
What impact will this have on the future of AI hardware?
